gloss: to go, to visit, to make the trip

definitions.gloss: to go, to visit, to take the trouble to come
definitions.explanation: A polite or humble way to express going somewhere, implying effort or deliberate action.

examples.japanese: ⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}んで⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for taking the trouble to come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}んで⟦{交渉|こうしょう}した→交渉：02727_koushou⟧。
examples.english: I visited many times to negotiate.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do come visit our store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}ぶ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I plan to visit the exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦にもかかわらず→にもかかわらず：06778_nimokakawarazu⟧、⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}んで⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: Despite the distant location, we sincerely thank you all for making the trip to visit us.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {足|あし} (foot, leg) + を + ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧ (to carry) — literally 'to carry one's feet' somewhere. The phrase foregrounds the effort of going, which is why it is the polite way to talk about someone else's visit.

REGISTER: Polite and slightly formal. Typical settings:
- thanking a visitor, especially a customer or guest
- inviting customers to a shop or an event
- speaking modestly about trips one made oneself

It is rarely used for casual visits between friends; ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ or ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ is normal there.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}ぶ: to take the trouble to come
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{足|あし}を{運|はこ}ぶ: to visit again and again
- {足|あし}を{運|はこ}んで⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: to have someone make the trip (humble, used in thanks)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go — neutral
- ⟦いらっしゃる→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧: to come, to go — honorific
- お⟦{越|こ}し→越す：02282_kosu⟧になる: to come — honorific, common in shop and event announcements
